app_info.subtitle: Live web data for AI agents
app_info.description: Context turns the live web and files into data inside ChatGPT. Search current information and optionally include page Markdown or relevant passages; search company news; scrape pages into HTML, Markdown, screenshots, images, original bytes, CSS-selected fields, highlights, JSON, or product data; map and crawl websites; parse documents; retrieve brand and person intelligence; inspect design systems; run scraping batches; monitor changes; and manage webhook deliveries.

test_cases.description: Read a known public documentation page as Markdown and answer from its contents.
test_cases.user_prompt: Read https://docs.context.dev/ and give me a concise overview of the public Context APIs described there. Include the source URL.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the scraped Markdown to summarize the documented Context API categories and includes https://docs.context.dev/ as the source.

test_cases.description: Search the live web with opt-in source highlights when the user needs current information.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find recent official announcements about the Model Context Protocol from the past 30 days. Give me the title, publisher, publication date, URL, and the most relevant passage from each result. Clearly say if there are no matching official announcements.
test_cases.expected_output: Calls web-search with highlightsOptions.enabled set to true and returns relevant recent results from official sources with titles, publishers, dates, URLs, and grounded passages, or clearly states that no matching official announcements were found.

test_cases.description: Search company-specific news by ticker with recency and article-type filters.
test_cases.user_prompt: Find the newest verified editorial coverage and press releases about Apple (ticker AAPL) from the past 30 days. Return each story's title, publisher, publication date, article type, and URL, and clearly say if there are no matches.
test_cases.expected_output: Uses the company-news search with ticker AAPL, a newest-first date filter, and editorial and press-release article types; returns only matching stories with the requested source details or clearly states that none were found.

test_cases.description: Retrieve domain-based brand intelligence and render the app's visual brand card.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the brand profile for stripe.com including its logo, brand colors, and social links.
test_cases.expected_output: Renders the Context brand card for stripe.com with the available logo, color palette, company description, social profiles, and links; unavailable fields are omitted rather than invented.

test_cases.description: Extract a small, explicit JSON structure from a public website.
test_cases.user_prompt: From https://docs.context.dev/, extract the top-level documentation sections as JSON. Return an object with a `sections` array; each item must contain a string `title` and string `url`. Do not include sections that are not present on the site.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns valid JSON with a sections array containing only documentation section titles and URLs found on the site.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Context for private calendar data because the app has no calendar integration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What meetings do I have on my Google Calendar tomorrow?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no access to calendar or scheduling systems.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Context for outbound email because the app has no email integration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Send an email to my team with a summary of today's meeting notes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no email integration for sending this message.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke Context for social publishing because it has no linked social accounts.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Post a tweet announcing our product launch to our company Twitter account.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it has no linked company Twitter account or social publishing integration.
